verdict.rationale: With `include_blocks`, Document AI returns per-page output in which each page has a blocks array of paragraph-level segments. Each block carries structural labels, bounding boxes and reading order, alongside separate header/footer fields and block-level confidence scores. This gives usable semantic boundaries and metadata, and Mistral positions the structured output as citation-ready input for RAG ingestion. However, there is no evidence of true RAG chunking: no chunk sizing, no merging of blocks into retrieval-sized segments, and no embedding-ready output. Missing for 10: explicit chunking with size/overlap control, embedding-ready segment output, section-hierarchy metadata per chunk, independent hands-on corroboration of block output for RAG.
